subject: Runtime capacity nomination and proposed offer bands for Q4 hires
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Avery Recruiting <avery@talentloop.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Runtime capacity nomination and proposed offer bands for Q4 hires

Team —

Following the capacity review last week, I’m formally nominating three runtime/platform hires for Q4 and requesting pre-approval of offer bands so TalentOps can move fast on candidates. High-level ask below; budget workbook and comp-band PDF attached.

What I’m requesting:
- Open 2x Senior Runtime Engineers (low-latency / KV cache ownership)
- Open 1x Platform Reliability Engineer (autoscaling, deployment orchestration)
- Pre-approve offer ranges and a $25k signing buffer for outlier candidates

Why now:
- We expect a 30% throughput increase with the Dedicated expansion; without the two Sr RTEs we’re at risk of sustained tail latency and on-call burn.
- The Platform Reliability hire is critical to automate the new autoscaling policies for Q4 customer rollouts (Dedicated customers + two enterprise pilots).

Cost summary (annualized fully loaded):
- Sr Runtime (x2): ~ $430k each (salary + benefits + equity run rate)
- Platform Reliability (x1): ~ $310k
- One-time hiring/relocation + signing buffers: ~$80k
- Total run-rate impact (new roles): ~$1.25M/year

Proposed bands (high-level):
- Sr Runtime Engineer: $200k-$300k base, total comp target $350k-$450k
- Platform Reliability Engineer: $150k-$225k base, total comp target $220k-$320k

Next steps I need from each of you by EOD Thurs:
- Laura: exec sign-off on the headcount and high-level run-rate (for exec summary)
- Rishi: confirmation that bands align with comp policy or note exceptions we should pre-approve
- Dev: brief bullet on priority and critical deliverables (to include in job profiles)
- Marissa: hiring timeline and whether we should convert two contractor slots first

Attachments: Q4_runtime_hc_budget.xlsx, comp_band_proposal_2027.pdf

Thanks — happy to discuss in 30 if helpful.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Runtime Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity nomination and proposed offer bands for Q4 hires

Monica —

Thanks for the write-up and the attachments. Quick notes from my side:

- The headcount ask is reasonable given the Dedicated expansion timeline, but we need to tighten the exec summary to call out customer impact (list two pilots + MRR at risk).
- I’m not comfortable pre-approving the full $25k signing buffer for all candidates; suggest we reserve that for exceptional cases and require two-level approval (you + me).
- Please add a short list of 3 must-have deliverables per role (Dev should fill this in) and an onboarding milestone plan (60/120/180 days).

If you can get that back to me by EOD Thursday, I’ll clear this for the finance review and prep a one-page for the exec sync next Monday.

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Runtime capacity nomination and proposed offer bands for Q4 hires

Laura / Monica —

Thanks — listing the 3 must-have deliverables per role below (short bullets to fold into the job posting):

Sr Runtime Engineer (x2):
- Deliverable 1: Reduce P95 generation time for long-context workloads by 20% within 90 days (KV cache improvements + kernel selection tuning).
- Deliverable 2: Implement prefix/KV cache invalidation strategy and deploy to staging pipeline by week 8.
- Deliverable 3: Own on-call runbook and reduce mean time to mitigate (MTTM) for memory pressure incidents by 35% (120-day goal).

Platform Reliability Engineer (x1):
- Deliverable 1: Automate autoscaling policies for Dedicated pools with safe rollout hooks (canary + metrics) within 60 days.
- Deliverable 2: Implement cost-aware routing integration to reduce per-token cost for low-priority workloads by 15% (90 days).
- Deliverable 3: Deliver a runbook and SLA playbook for enterprise pilot customers (120 days).

Hiring timeline (provisional):
- Reqs live: Sep 20
- First-round screens: Sep 27 - Oct 8
- Final onsite loop: Oct 11 - Oct 22
- Offers out: Oct 25 - Nov 1

I’m comfortable with the proposed bands for Sr RTEs given marketplace comps — will prioritize diversity slate and internal referrals first.

— Dev
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Cameron Lee <cameron@zenithfin.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity nomination and proposed offer bands for Q4 hires

Team —

I reviewed the comp-band proposal. My take: the Sr Runtime band is market-competitive and I can authorize an exception to the comp policy up to the top 10% of the proposed band for critical candidates (i.e., allow offers that land near $320k base in exceptional cases) provided we get written finance confirmation on the equity uplift and that any signing bonus over $15k is routed through you, Laura, for final sign-off.

Action items for Finance (cc'ed Cameron at ZenithFin to expedite):
- Confirm headcount run-rate accounting and whether we have cushion in the Q4 hiring bucket to absorb the uplift.
- Approve the proposed amortization for signing bonuses and relocation in the attached budget workbook.

I’ll document the comp exception in the hiring ticket once I have Laura’s greenlight.

Rishi
Head of Total Rewards (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Avery Recruiting <avery@talentloop.com>, TalentOps <talentops@hiringhub.io>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runtime capacity nomination and proposed offer bands for Q4 hires

All —

Based on the updated deliverables and Rishi's note, I approve opening the three reqs and pre-approving the proposed bands with the guardrails described:
- Signing buffer: up to $15k auto-approved; above that requires Laura + Monica written sign-off.
- Comp exception: Rishi may authorize offers up to the 90th percentile for critical candidates with accompanying rationale.
- Hiring timeline: proceed on the provisional timeline; TalentOps / Avery to prioritize candidate screens and present 3-slate by Oct 8.

Cameron (cc): please confirm finance seat on this and flag any run-rate accounting issues by EOD Friday so we can include this in the Monday exec summary.

Monica: please work with Avery and TalentOps to finalize JD drafts and candidate scorecards; mark the hiring tickets with the comp exception tag once Rishi records it.

Laura
